seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of Stable Diffusion
            will output the same image every time.

image.title: Image Url
image.description: The URL of the image to upscale.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to use for generating the image. Be as descriptive as possible for best results.

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.description:
The creativity of the model. The higher the creativity, the more the model will deviate from the prompt.
            Refers to the denoise strength of the sampling.

resemblance.title: Resemblance
resemblance.description:
The resemblance of the upscaled image to the original image. The higher the resemblance, the more the model will try to keep the original image.
            Refers to the strength of the ControlNet.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

readme:
# Clarity Upscaler

Clarity Upscaler enlarges an image up to 4× while adding detail; `creativity` and `resemblance` balance new detail against faithfulness.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | `masterpiece, best quality, highres` | Describe the content to guide added detail. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | Image to upscale. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `guidance_scale` | number 0–20 | 4 | How strictly to follow the prompt. |
| `num_inference_steps` | integer 4–50 | 18 | More steps add detail and time. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `upscale_factor` | number 1–4 | 2 | 1–4×. |
| `resemblance` | number 0–1 | 0.6 | Higher stays closer to the input. |
| `creativity` | number 0–1 | 0.35 | Higher adds more invented detail. |

## Billing

$0.03 per image.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.03 |

Failed runs are not charged.
